evals.name: start
evals.prompt: I want to build a Telegram bot in Python to learn how bots work. Get me going.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds the first milestone (skeleton + config) with TODOs; no full-featured bot; Says the bot token must come from an env var/.env that is gitignored, not hard-coded

assertions.text: Routes correctly: reads the build-your-own-x router SKILL.md and the 'bot' track skill before answering
